source_text: The multigrid algorithm is an iterative solver. For each k there is an iteration scheme for solving the equation A_k z = g on V_k. This scheme has two main features: smoothing on V_k and error correction on V_{k-1}, using the iteration scheme developed on V_{k-1}. The smoothing step damps the oscillatory part of the error, while the smooth part can be captured on the coarser grid.
translated_text: 多重网格算法是一种迭代求解器. 对于每个 k, 都有一个在 V_k 上求解 A_k z=g 的迭代方案. 该方案在 V_k 上进行光滑化, 并在 V_{k-1} 上进行误差校正.
